outcomes.observation: The portrait now reads as an earnest, animated 1995 teacher rather than a polished generic librarian.
outcomes.artifactLocator: Face, pencil, glasses and red-white wardrobe.

outcomes.observation: The adult graphic-novel treatment and restrained Library backdrop fit SUNNYVAiLE without turning the identity proof into a room redesign.
The compact messy bob, pale eyes, oversized round wire glasses, narrow face and awkward open expression visibly carry the bound Ms Geist cues while remaining illustrated.
Face, glasses, ears, pearl studs, pencil, wrist and five visible fingers are coherent and connected.
There is no generated signage, label, logo, watermark or pseudo-lettering.
The cherry-red textured sweater over an oversized pointed white collar is specific to the bound 1995 classroom reference and replaces the rejected paisley-cardigan costume.
Only the identity-supporting pencil, glasses, books, lamp and beige CRT are present; no decorative card catalogue or brooch remains.
At 260 by 390, the face, blue-grey eyes, huge round glasses, messy bob, pencil and red-white outfit remain clear.

lineage.comparison: The v4 pilot removes the predecessor's over-aged face, glamorous salon curls, ornate chain glasses, paisley blouse, dark teal cardigan and generic librarian styling; it materially shrinks the v2/v3 hair footprint into a compact untidy bob.
